description:
COACTUPC's cross-reference NOTFND path for account 99999999999, and the case that owns the DFHRESP(NOTFND) arm of the CXACAIX call site (gate G47) - case04 owns that site's NORMAL arm and case08 its WHEN OTHER. THE ONLY LIVE GUARD IN THE WHOLE READ CHAIN IS THIS CASE'S SUBJECT, and that is why the case exists: 9000-READ-ACCT :3608-3644 runs four paragraphs behind three guards, and only the first guard can ever fire. :3620-3622 IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK GO TO 9000-READ-ACCT-EXIT DOES fire here, so 9300-GETACCTDATA-BYACCT, 9400-GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST and 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA are ALL skipped. The other two guards - :3627-3629 IF DID-NOT-FIND-ACCT-IN-ACCTDAT and :3636-3638 IF DID-NOT-FIND-CUST-IN-CUSTDAT - test 88-levels of WS-RETURN-MSG rather than of a read flag, and their setting SETs are commented out at :3719 and :3769, so neither can be true when the read that would have set them has failed; cases 06 and 07 demonstrate those two dead guards, and this case is their control. Nothing about that asymmetry is repaired here (practice B5): the Java translation keeps one live guard and two that cannot fire, exactly as the COBOL has them. THE SEED IS A MEASURED FACT, NOT A CONVENIENCE. The inbound ACCTSIDI is 99999999999 and the substring 99999999999 occurs in ZERO rows of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt and in ZERO rows of app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt - both files were scanned row by row - so the NOTFND is reached by the seeded data itself and forcedOutcomes is empty. That matters for G47: an arm reached by real absent data is a stronger assertion than one reached by a forced outcome, and it is the only arm of this site for which no forcing is needed. The four seeds are byte-identical to case04's so that the divergence between the two cases is the search key alone: CXACAIX cardxref.txt row 48, ACCTDAT acctdata.txt row 0, CUSTDAT custdata.txt row 0, CARDDAT carddata.txt row 48, one row each. THE ENTRY. EIBCALEN is the full 1033 bytes COMMON-RETURN :1010-1018 returns - 160 for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus 873 for WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false too: the ELSE at :887-892 restores both areas from DFHCOMMAREA. The carried CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1 and ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED. AID is DFHENTER and the source forces that choice: the validity gate :905-912 accepts PF12 only in the conjunction (CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND NOT ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED) at :910, so with the details unfetched :914-916 would REMAP PF12 to CCARD-AID-ENTER before any dispatch saw it. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 lands on WHEN OTHER :996-1003 - :927 PF03 false, :964-965 needs CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and the context is REENTER, :966-967 needs CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-MENUPGM, :979 and :980 need a change action this state has not reached - and that arm performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP before the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. THE EDIT. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP :1051-1062 finds ACCTSIDI neither '*' nor SPACES, so it MOVEs it into CC-ACCT-ID and ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X and then :1060-1062 GO TOes its exit because the details are unfetched - so exactly one map field is received and no other is read. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1433-1447 performs 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT, MOVEs LOW-VALUES to ACUP-OLD-ACCT-DATA at :1438 and GO TOes the exit at :1446, so no non-key field is edited and none is flagged. 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT :1783-1818 SETs FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK first at :1784, then finds the key present, numeric and non-zero, so the ELSE at :1814-1816 MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID into CDEMO-ACCT-ID and SETs FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID. That ISVALID is the guard 2000-DECIDE-ACTION's first arm tests at :2573 before SETting WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :2574 and performing 9000-READ-ACCT at :2575 - and it is ALSO the flag the read is about to overwrite. THE READ. 9200-GETCARDXREF-BYACCT :3650-3697 issues EXEC CICS READ DATASET(LIT-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH) RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X) INTO(CARD-XREF-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-XREF-RECORD) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD). GATE G45 IS PART OF THIS CASE: LIT-CARDXREFNAME-ACCT-PATH is PIC X(8) VALUE 'CXACAIX ' at :581-582, and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:63-65 defines CXACAIX as ALTERNATE INDEX TO CCXREF VIA ACCOUNT KEY over AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.AIX.PATH - an alternate-index PATH over the CCXREF base and never a second table - so the one cardxref.txt seed serves both access paths and there is no separate cross-reference-by-account dataset in inputs. The EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :3664 takes its NOTFND arm :3668-3685 in exactly this order: (1) :3669 SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE; (2) :3670 SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE, which replaces the ISVALID that 1210 had just set; (3) :3671 IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF - true, because :2574 SET it off - then :3672 MOVE WS-RESP-CD TO ERROR-RESP, :3673 MOVE WS-REAS-CD TO ERROR-RESP2, and the seven-operand STRING at :3674-3684. THE COMPOSED MESSAGE, BYTE BY BYTE. The operands are 'Account:' :3675 which is 8, WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X :3676 which is PIC X(11) at :382-383 and holds 99999999999, ' not found in' :3677 which is 13, ' Cross ref file.  Resp:' :3678 which is 23, ERROR-RESP :3679 which is PIC X(10) at :401, ' Reas:' :3680 which is 6, and ERROR-RESP2 :3681 which is PIC X(10) at :405. THE LITERAL AT :3678 CARRIES TWO SPACES AFTER THE PERIOD and it is reproduced byte for byte: the period sits at offset 15 of the 23-byte literal and offsets 16 and 17 are both blanks. It was lifted programmatically out of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:3678 and asserted rather than retyped, because collapsing it to one space is the single most likely way to make this case pass a reading and fail a byte comparison, and practice B5 forbids tidying it. WS-RESP-CD and WS-REAS-CD are PIC S9(09) COMP at :40-43, so a MOVE into a PIC X(10) alphanumeric renders the sending item as NINE display digits, left-justified, with ONE trailing space: DFHRESP(NOTFND) is 13 - common.FileStatus.NOTFND - so ERROR-RESP becomes '000000013 ', and the reason code is common.FileStatus.NO_REASON_CODE, which CICS sets when a condition carries no qualifying reason, so ERROR-RESP2 becomes '000000000 '. The seven operands assemble to 8+11+13+23+10+6+10 = 81 characters, and WS-RETURN-MSG is PIC X(75) at :479. STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO fills the receiver left to right and STOPS at its end, so the last SIX characters - '00000 ', the tail of ERROR-RESP2 - are NOT stored. What lands in WS-RETURN-MSG is therefore the 75 bytes 'Account:99999999999 not found in Cross ref file.  Resp:000000013  Reas:0000', ending mid-reason-code, and the two blanks between the RESP digits and 'Reas:' are one from ERROR-RESP's own trailing pad and one from the leading blank of the ' Reas:' literal. COMMON-RETURN :1008 then MOVEs it to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, itself PIC X(75) at app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:28, and 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2981 MOVEs it to ERRMSGO, which app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY declares PIC X(78), so the screen field is those 75 bytes plus THREE trailing spaces. The truncation is behaviour and is asserted, not smoothed over. THE CONSEQUENCES OF THE GUARD FIRING. ACUP-OLD-DETAILS stays exactly as the INITIALIZE at the head of 9000-READ-ACCT :3610 left it, with only ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID overwritten by :3614; those items are WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA rather than a dataset, so they are stated here in prose rather than pinned as a record, exactly as case04 states its own snapshot - ExpectedResponse.navigation admits CDEMO- names and ExpectedRecord.dataset admits a dataset binding key, and inventing either spelling for a working-storage area would assert against a layout no repository has. CDEMO-CUST-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM are NOT populated, because the two MOVEs that would have populated them are :3666-3667 in the NORMAL arm; they are pinned in navigation at their arriving values of nine zeros and sixteen zeros as the positive evidence that the NORMAL arm was not taken. CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, -MNAME, -LNAME and CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS likewise stay as they arrived, because only 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA writes them. CDEMO-ACCT-ID is the one commarea field that changes, and 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT :1815 is what changed it. ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION stays ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, because 2000-DECIDE-ACTION :2577-2579 SETs ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS only IF FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER and 9400 never ran. THE SCREEN. 3000-SEND-MAP :2649-2661 applies five paragraphs. (1) 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2669 MOVEs LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO, then :2673-2690 assigns the six header items - TITLE01O and TITLE02O from the ACTIVE literals at app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-19 and :22, TRNNAMEO CAUP, PGMNAMEO COACTUPC, and CURDATEO mm/dd/yy with CURTIMEO hh:mm:ss from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE. (2) 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2698-2726 takes the ELSE because the context is REENTER; the IF at :2703-2704 needs CC-ACCT-ID-N = 0 AND FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID and neither holds, so the ELSE at :2706-2707 MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO and the screen echoes 99999999999 back at the user. (3) Its order-sensitive EVALUATE at :2710-2724 lands on the FIRST arm, WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2711, so 3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES :2731-2785 runs and 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES does not - and THAT is the divergence from case04. 3201 MOVEs LOW-VALUES to exactly FORTY-TWO data items, which the LOW-VALUES of :2669 had already left them at, so the paragraph is idempotent here and the forty-two are pinned at LOW-VALUES to prove the account, customer and card panes were never painted. Every one of the five monetary items is therefore LOW-VALUES rather than an edited amount: WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F at :371 is never used on this path, and the five COMPUTE sites at :1079, :1093, :1107, :1121 and :1135 sit in the part of 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS that :1446 skips, so no arithmetic runs at all - which is why gates G22 to G29 belong to other cases and not to this one. (4) 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2955-2982 is order-sensitive too: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-ENTER at :2958 is false, so it lands on WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :2960 and SETs PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS - WS-INFO-MSG is PIC X(40) at :463 holding the 39-character literal at :468-469 - which :2979 MOVEs into INFOMSGO PIC X(45), right-space-padded to 45, and then :2981 MOVEs the composed 75-byte WS-RETURN-MSG into ERRMSGO PIC X(78). The two writes are in that order in the source, and they are pinned in that order in the ordered fields map: the information line first, the single error line second. (5) FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:493-507 and are never assigned by the program. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANES, AND THE NOT-OK HALF OF GATE G38. 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS at :2986 performs 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS and then, at the WHEN ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED arm :2994-2996, MOVEs DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA OF CACTUPAI so the account id alone is enterable. That xxxA item is deliberately NOT declared: it belongs to the INPUT redefine CACTUPAI, not to the sent CACTUPAO, and ScreenSend.attributes admits only the output planes whose names end in C, P, H or V. The SETUP COLOR block follows. :3171-3173 IF CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET EQUAL LIT-CCLISTMAPSET is false, because the carried CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET is seven spaces and LIT-CCLISTMAPSET is COCRDLI at :553-554. :3176-3178 IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CACTUPAO IS TRUE, so the account id turns red - and note that this block, unlike the CSSETATY expansion whose shape it copies, is NOT guarded by CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, so the colour would be applied on either context. :3180-3184 IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE, because 1210 reached its ELSE and never SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK, so there is NO '*' overlay: ACCTSIDO keeps the echoed key rather than being replaced by an asterisk, which is exactly how this case differs from case02. That pairing - DFHRED WITHOUT the '*' - is the second half of gate G38's error-highlight matrix, and app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy is where the rule is written: DFHRED on (NOT-OK OR BLANK) AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, and the '*' only inside the nested IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK. The context here IS REENTER, so the guard is satisfied and the red is real rather than suppressed. Then :3186-3192 IF ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED OR FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK OR FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK GO TO 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT fires on its FIRST and THIRD disjuncts together, so all THIRTY-NINE CSSETATY expansions from :3208 onwards are SKIPPED - they would each have been a no-op anyway, since 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS flagged nothing, and the distinction between skipped and no-op is invisible on the wire but is stated here so the reason the plane is clean is not mistaken for the reason case04's plane is clean. Every remaining colour is the default DFHDFCOL and every highlight the default DFHDFHI, both x'00' exactly as MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO left them, except the information line: 3390-SETUP-INFOMSG-ATTRS :3567-3571 sets it bright with DFHBMASB because WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is false - there IS a message. FKEY05 and FKEY12 stay hidden, because :3573-3576 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE and :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION. THE CURSOR IS ACCTSIDL, reached by the SECOND arm group of an order-sensitive EVALUATE and not by WHEN OTHER, and the difference is worth stating because both land on the same field. At :3010 FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA is false, because 3250 left WS-INFO-MSG holding the search-key prompt rather than 'Details of selected account shown above'. At :3011 NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is false, because WS-RETURN-MSG holds the composed NOTFND text rather than 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.'. At :3013-3014 WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is TRUE, so :3015 MOVEs -1 TO ACCTSIDL and the thirty-odd non-key arms from :3017 to :3164 are never evaluated. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, so the xxxL item IS the cursor and ACCTSIDL is named for that reason rather than as a payload field. THE NEXT TARGET is COACTUPC / COACTUP / CACTUPA, and all three are set by 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS :1031-1033, which MOVEs LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, -MAPSET and -MAP. Termination is RETURN_TRANSID from :1015-1018, never XCTL: the only XCTL in this program is at :956-959 inside the PF03 arm, which this path does not reach. STATELESSNESS, rule R6 and gate G37. Every scrap of conversation state travels in the payload and none of it is held on the server. Inbound it is screenRequest - the 1033-byte EIBCALEN, the AID, the sixteen carried CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields and ONE received map field. ACCTSIDI is the only one there can be: 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3496 protects all fifty input fields and :2996 then MOVEs DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA alone, so the prompt screen the previous turn sent left exactly one field enterable and a terminal has nothing else modified to return. Outbound it is the sixteen navigation fields plus the send. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT stays 1 - this arm never re-SETs it - and CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, -FROM-PROGRAM, -TO-TRANID, -TO-PROGRAM, -USER-ID, -USER-TYPE, -LAST-MAP and -LAST-MAPSET stay exactly as they arrived, because the only arm that writes any of them is the PF03 arm at :933-950 - and CDEMO-USER-ID is written nowhere in this program at all. NOTHING IS WRITTEN, AND NO RECORD PROJECTION BELONGS TO THIS CASE. COACTUPC's write verbs are the read-for-update and REWRITE pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING :3888-4104, which only the PF05 confirmation arm at :2602-2605 reaches, so expectedWrites is empty as a POSITIVE assertion - FieldDiffer reports any dataset a unit writes to that the case does not address, so an empty list is a claim rather than a silence. expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are empty for a different and equally deliberate reason: not one record was successfully read on this path, so there is no decoded record for this case to project. The 300-byte account, the 500-byte customer, the 50-byte cross-reference and the 150-byte card are pinned field by field and as whole images by case04, which states in its own description that it carries gates G19 and G21 for cases 05 through 08 and 18 through 20; repeating them here would duplicate that contract without adding an assertion, while declaring a dataset-level row count without pinning the rows underneath it would make every seeded row an unaccounted row by FieldDiffer's own rule that a count is never a substitute for reading the bytes. This case's fingerprint is its response and its return code, which is precisely what a path whose only I/O was one failed keyed read produces. expectedMessages IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE FIRST-MESSAGE-WINS ASSERTION RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. Every message write in this program is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, :2574 SET it off immediately before the read, and the NOTFND arm's own :3671 guard is therefore the one that fires - so exactly ONE error text exists for this turn and no later write can displace it. Where that text is observable is the point: COACTUPC contains ZERO DISPLAY verbs and declares no WS-MESSAGE field, so neither the DISPLAY_LINE nor the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel can carry anything, and MessageChannel publishes no 45-byte channel for the information line either. Both lines are therefore pinned where the program actually put them and in the order it put them there - INFOMSGO at its declared 45 and then ERRMSGO at its declared 78, adjacent in the ordered fields map in the same sequence as :2979 and :2981 - and the empty list asserts that the unit emits no line on any channel at all. Declaring the composed text on DISPLAY_LINE would claim a verb this program does not contain. RETURN CODE 0. COACTUPC never sets a COBOL RETURN-CODE - the identifier does not occur anywhere in its 4,236 lines - because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. A CICS RESP is not a return code: DFHRESP(NOTFND) is 13, it is rendered into the message text as '000000013 ' and nowhere else, and mapping it to a step return code would invent a batch semantic this program has none of. THE SEED WIDTH, gate G16 and risk R-F. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded: app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares CARD-XREF-RECORD as XREF-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) plus XREF-CUST-ID PIC 9(09) plus XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) plus FILLER PIC X(14), which is 50, and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER, so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time. Pre-padding the input would double-pad it. All fifty rows of the file measure exactly 36 and row 48 is the cross-reference for account 00000000001 - the row case04 reads successfully and this case deliberately does not ask for. TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE and are recorded as such rather than silently skipped. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's fifty-one GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage, and CBSTM03A is the only program in the migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC - the nine sites are all in batch programs - and the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') at :4223 inside ABEND-ROUTINE :4203-4225 is unreachable on a path that took a named EVALUATE arm rather than a WHEN OTHER. G51 is honoured by unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO: account.AccountUpdateController is constructed directly with fixture-backed repositories and its handler called as a plain method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path. PROVENANCE, practice B12. Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY: by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:35-50, :371, :382-383, :389-410, :455-500, :530-590, :859-1020, :1022-1062, :1429-1449, :1783-1822, :2562-2582, :2649-2729, :2731-2786, :2955-2983, :2986-3020, :3160-3195, :3560-3605, :3608-3648 and :3650-3697, together with the PICTURE-clause widths of app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy and app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the CSSETATY rule in app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, the alternate-index definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:63-65, and the measured content of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt and acctdata.txt - including the VERIFIED ABSENCE of key 99999999999 from both, which is what makes the NOTFND arm reachable from the seed. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. GOVERNING PRACTICES. review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', so NO user-specified rule governs this file; none is cited and none is invented, and the absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. Enterprise best practice governs instead: B1, no placeholder value anywhere - every field carries a derived byte string; B3, the COBOL, copybook, BMS, CSD and data trees are read-only and not one byte of them was modified; B5, the two-space ' Cross ref file.  Resp:' span and the nine-digits-plus-one-space rendering of a PIC S9(09) COMP moved into a PIC X(10) receiver are reproduced exactly, along with the 81-into-75 truncation, with nothing normalised and nothing tidied; B7, the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59 - this source revision's own timestamp, every file carrying 'Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:15:5x CDT' - so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach, and every collection is ordered; B8, every expectation is an explicit field-to-value pair and the charset is named US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default; B11, every width comes from a PICTURE clause read in the source rather than from a count of the characters in a sentence; B12, the provenance above is stated honestly. AN AUTHORING NOTE. COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory, and allocates its own case05 to a different scenario. The divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - the cross-reference NOTFND that fires the read chain's only live guard - is what this case is specified to pin.

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

fields.INFOMSGO: Enter or update id of account to update
fields.ERRMSGO: Account:99999999999 not found in Cross ref file.  Resp:000000013  Reas:0000
